name: Relapse
summary: Browser + kernel exploit chain for PS5 firmware 7.00–13.60, ending in an ELF loader.
description: A public exploit chain combining a WebKit entry point with a kernel bug to obtain kernel read/write and start an ELF loader on port 9021. Firmware 14.00 and above are outside the supported window. The exploit is temporary and must be re-run after a full reboot.
author: ntfargo and contributors

firmware.notes: Only specific builds are supported; check the project's live list.

warnings: Can hang or kernel-panic the console; may need several attempts.
A newer system update can close the entry point.
